FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'orders'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()

FROM duckdb_constraints()

  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()

       constraint_column_names, referenced_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'orders'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
  AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'

SELECT constraint_index, referenced_table,
       constraint_column_names, referenced_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'users'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
  AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "order_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "orders"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "users"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as min_date,
  MAX(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as max_date
FROM "orders"

SELECT "user_id"
FROM (SELECT * FROM "users"
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL)
USING SAMPLE reservoir(10000 ROWS) REPEATABLE (42)

SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, "price", "ts"
FROM "tmp_orders_user_id_132942924272944" tmp
JOIN "orders"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) <= tmp.__kumo_end__
 AND CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) > tmp.__kumo_start__

SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__) AS __kumo_matches__, "user_id", "age", "country"
FROM "tmp_users_user_id_132943332691248" tmp
JOIN "users"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
) = 1

SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts"
FROM "tmp_orders_user_id_132943287532720" tmp
JOIN "orders"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) <= tmp.__kumo_time__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
  ORDER BY CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, "order_id"
) <= 32
ORDER BY tmp.__kumo_batch__, CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, "order_id"
